Name: Nyapu-Inspired Younger Morris - Compatible with Marry Morris
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
I've long loved both Nyapu's portraits and the Marry Morris mod, and I made these portraits for myself for my next playthrough. I thought they turned out okay so I wanted to share them with you all too! They are made by editing assets from Nyapu's portrait mods and some online pixel art tutorials, lol. I'm new to pixel art so if anyone has suggestions I'd love to hear them :)

Thanks to Nyapu for the original inspiration for these portraits and for their permissions which allows me and many others to edit their portraits for further portrait mods. Any thanks for this mod should go straight to them!

-------------------

COMPATIBILITY
----------------

This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, as well as any other mods that don't edit Morris' portrait. It is not compatible with other mods that edit Morris' portrait, but sprite edits are compatible. This won't work with Seasonal Cute Characters or other seasonal portrait mods.



LIMITATIONS
-------------

I'm new at pixel art so this mod only includes expressions from the Nyapu portrait I was editing - no glasses askew for Morris, just a cooky angry portrait. This is fine for me, but others may find it jarring at times lol.

Also, this mod doesn't include portraits for the winter variation of Morris. I may add these in the future if I get better at pixel art, but for the moment he is just going to be a little chilly in the winter time.



INSTALLATION
---------------

This mod works by replacing the image files in the Marry Morris mod and the Nyapu Portrait Mods. It can also replace the portraits in the Stardew Valley Expanded mod and Nyapu's SVE portraits if you have them installed.

When you download this mod, unzip it. You should see 4 folders titled with the mods that can have their portraits replaced. Drag whichever ones you need into your mod folder and let them replace the images when you are prompted. And you are done!
